user.title: Flighttracker
user.description:
Shows which airliner is flying overhead right now. Choose the place to watch and the radius (max. 100 km).

OpenSky API client credentials are optional: without them you get 400 requests per day, with a free OpenSky account 4000. Create an API client on your OpenSky account page.

data_description.client_id: Optional. Leave empty to use OpenSky anonymously.

reconfigure.title: Change location or credentials
reconfigure.description: Leave the client secret empty to keep the stored one.

reauth_confirm.title: OpenSky credentials rejected
reauth_confirm.description: OpenSky did not accept the API client. Enter new credentials, or leave both fields empty to continue anonymously.

error.invalid_auth: OpenSky rejected the client ID or secret.
error.credentials_incomplete: Enter both client ID and client secret, or neither.
error.radius_too_large: The radius may be at most 100 km.

abort.already_configured: This location is already set up.

init.title: Flighttracker options
init.description: Your OpenSky quota is {credits} requests per day. Every update uses one.

data.route_required: Only flights with a known route

data_description.route_required: Like the original e-paper display: skip private planes and flights adsbdb has no route for.
data_description.logo_url: {icao} is replaced by the airline ICAO code (e.g. DLH). Leave empty for no logos.

error.too_many_requests: These settings need {requests} requests per day, but the quota is {credits}. Choose a longer interval or enable quiet hours.
